hooks.name: Auto Git Push on File Save
hooks.description: Automatically stages, commits, and pushes all changes to origin/main whenever a file is saved in the workspace.

action.command: cd "c:\Users\USER\Downloads\rillcod-academy-main\rillcod-academy-main" ; git add -A ; $msg = "Auto-save: $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')" ; git diff --cached --quiet ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { git commit -m $msg ; git push origin main }
